parts.target: An **[unengaged](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** unit of yours up to 12" from any enemy unit. A **VEHICLE** unit qualifies only if it is also a **CHARACTER** or **WALKER** unit.
parts.effect:
The unit **resolves a charge**. Before it makes its **[charge roll](vsdata:core-rule/charge-step)**, you must pick one of these modes:

- **Leap to Defend**: as **charge targets**, it can pick only enemy units that have made a **[charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move)** in the phase and that its **maximum distance** reaches.

data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Charge phase](vsdata:core-rule/charge-phase), as it ends.

**Target:** An **[unengaged](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** unit of yours up to 12" from any enemy unit. A **VEHICLE** unit qualifies only if it is also a **CHARACTER** or **WALKER** unit.

**Effect:** The unit **resolves a charge**. Before it makes its **[charge roll](vsdata:core-rule/charge-step)**, you must pick one of these modes:

- **Leap to Defend**: as **charge targets**, it can pick only enemy units that have made a **[charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move)** in the phase and that its **maximum distance** reaches.
- **Into the Fray**: a charge roll above 6 after modifiers counts as 6, and as charge targets it can pick any enemy units up to 6" from it that its maximum distance reaches.
